title: Cardinal Morosini, legate in France, to Cardinal Montalto, spring 1589, two enclosures in the second key F22b (AAV Segr. Stato Francia 22/32-33, DECODE R53, R54)

steps.what: Fetched the DECODE records R18-R58 with the session cookie; R53/R54 carry a second key file (Lasry, 'ASV - F22b').
Wrote decrypt.py: beam search over 1-3 digit segmentations with the Italian 5-gram model, nomenclator for dotted codes.
Applied Lasry's partial F22b reconstruction (~70 elements) to R53/R54.
Partial-reading audit: R53/R54 listed as the open gap of the Francia 22 entry (second key, no further key material).
Meister 1906 (OCR) searched for a second Morosini key: index lists him only at p. 393 (no. 40); no. 32 (Bishop of Brescia with Rinalducci, 1585-90) is a cover-name list, not this syllabary.
rebuild.py: values for the 24 empty two-figure codes by coordinate ascent on the decoder's LM score, Lasry's values fixed, fitted on R53 and on R54 separately.
Held-out check of the two fits: they agree on 1 code of about 10 (84 c) and each breaks readable stretches of the other record; no value adopted, reading kept on Lasry's key.
measure_sense.py: 0.752 of decoded letters in attested Italian words (R53 0.791, R54 0.707) against 0.817 for the 34 fully read Meister-key records.
Split from morosini1588 under the one-key rule: R53/R54 (F22b key) made their own entry; transcriptions, Lasry's key files and the decoder output moved here; Lasry credit scoped to the F22b key.

outcome.method_basis: George Lasry's partial reconstruction of the F22b key, filed on DECODE R53/R54 before the attempt, was applied with the morosini1588 segmenting decoder; R53 reads in most of its length, R54 in fragments; a key-rebuild from the two records was tried and not adopted.

gaps.item: R53, R54: the stretches that do not read as sense (about a quarter of R53, more of R54)
gaps.detail: Lasry's F22b reconstruction (about 70 elements) is the only key material; Meister 1906 prints no second Morosini key; no decipherment or clear copy on the records; a rebuild from these 1,448 figures does not fix the missing values

gaps.item: R53, R54 nomenclator groups outside Lasry's list

outcome.notes: Split 14 Oct 2026 from morosini1588 (one key per entry). Measured 14 Oct 2026 (sense measure, see fraction_read_source). Key-rebuild by coordinate ascent on the 24 empty two-figure codes: fits on R53 and on R54 agree on one code of about ten and break each other's readable stretches; not adopted.

credits.note: partial reconstruction of the F22b key (about 70 elements), applied to R53/R54

outcome.fraction_read_source: targets/morosini1589/measure_sense.py: share of decoded letters in Italian word forms attested at least twice in the it-cinquecento corpora, after the LM word split (decode_updates/decryptions/R53.txt, R54.txt): R53 0.791, R54 0.707, both 893/1,187. Control: the 34 fully read Meister no. 40 records score 0.817 by the same measure. An upper bound on text read as sense.

prior.where: Lasry's partial F22b key reconstruction on DECODE R53/R54 (D3187/D3188, 24 Oct 2020); no decryption posted

human: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code and posed the problem; no target-specific intervention recorded.
